reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and $360 for a paper pendant is a lot to risk on a store with no track record I can check. I walked out of a showroom last weekend without buying, so I'm not in a rush for this one.
objection: Unknown brand at $360, and if I change my mind I eat the return shipping on a big, bulky fixture. Ten percent off doesn't make up for that risk when I can compare the total at other stores.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, plus real reviews or trade/pro pricing, would flip it. I'd also want to see the same pendant priced clearly below what I'd pay elsewhere, around $250 after discount.
